build_glm_asr_model: build a GLM-ASR conditional generation model with audio encoder and language model for speech-to-text
create_glm_asr_encoder: create a GLM-ASR audio encoder with convolutional layers and transformer blocks with rotary embeddings
test_glm_asr_processor: test the GLM-ASR multimodal processor for converting audio inputs into model-ready token prompts
refactor_glm_asr_attention: refactor the GLM-ASR encoder attention layer to use grouped query attention with fused QKV projections
summarize_glm_asr_projector: summarize the GLM-ASR multi-modal projector that maps audio encoder outputs to language model hidden space
